title: Cadmies Gui Features
definition: The primary functionalities provided by the CADMIES Graphical User Interface.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of the CADMIES GUI as a special toolkit that helps you create, view, and manage concepts. It's like a digital notebook for your ideas, all on your own computer.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The CADMIES GUI offers features such as a dashboard, add concept form, concept library, audit trail, and mycelium map. These tools enable you to navigate and interact with the CADMIES-IPLD system effectively.
difficulty_levels.expert: The CADMIES GUI is a user-friendly interface that encapsulates the functionalities of the CADMIES-IPLD system. By providing a graphical representation of the system, it allows users to better understand and interact with the concepts stored within. Furthermore, the air-gapped nature of the GUI ensures data privacy and security, making it a suitable tool for sensitive information.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES GUI provides a comprehensive set of features that enable users to interact with the CADMIES-IPLD system in a user-friendly and secure manner.
